visible_condition: Pristine factory condition (due to stock photos)
hidden_risks: Actual physical wear and tear of the used item
Functionality of the heating bed, extruder, and motherboard
Missing components, tools, or filament samples
Whether the seller actually possesses the physical item
response.best_proof: Real, unedited photos of the actual physical unit being sold, including power-on display
response.drop_reason: Photos are stock or catalogue promotional images with watermarks, not pictures of the actual second-hand item being sold.
response.failure_mode: Treating stock promotional photos as the actual item's physical condition, leading to incorrect valuation of a used machine.
